fills.researcher_notes: RE-RESEARCHED 2026-09-14 by the orchestrator. The prior pass cited the EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects workbook for this unit; EIA has NO ownership column at all -- its single company field is 'Pipeline Operator Name', which is an operator fact, not an equity fact -- so that citation could never support Owner and has been removed. Re-grounded on the owner's own SEC filing. The ref names the project and attributes it to Kinder Morgan, but it CONTRADICTS the recorded ownership in two ways and the reviewer should treat this as an attribution finding, not a clean confirmation. (1) The equity is shared: the only public description of the project calls it a partnership between KMI and BCP (the EagleClaw/Altus midstream platform that became Kinetik), so Owner1%=100.00% is not supported. (2) The entity named is wrong in time: 'Kinder Morgan Energy Partners' (KMP) was the MLP that Kinder Morgan, Inc. bought in and consolidated in 2014, seven years before this project existed; the correct 2021 entity is Kinder Morgan, Inc. RECOMMEND Owner1='Kinder Morgan' with the percentage cleared pending the split, and Owner2 opened for the BCP/Kinetik side. The project is recorded cancelled in EIA, so no later filing carries it.
